privacy.title: Privacy and my data

consents.platform: Terms of service and privacy policy
consents.share_with_therapist: Share my summary with my specialist

privacy.requiredHint: We can't provide the service without it.
privacy.aiDialogBody: If you withdraw your consent, AI-assisted features will stop, such as the intake chat and the summary it prepares for your specialist. Our human team and the emergency team stay available as usual, and you can turn it back on at any time.
privacy.accessEmpty: No one has opened your file yet.
privacy.export: Download a copy of my data
privacy.exportStarted: We've received your request. Your copy will be ready within 7 days.
privacy.deleteHint: We keep only what the law requires
privacy.deleteDialogBody: We'll delete your account, chats, homework and upcoming appointments. We keep only the health records the law requires. This can't be undone.
privacy.aiDialogDelete: I would rather delete my account
privacy.locationDialogTitle: Stop sharing your location in an emergency?
privacy.locationDialogBody: If you are in danger and we can't reach you, the on-call clinician won't know where to send help. You can turn it back on at any time.
privacy.exportDialogTitle: Download a copy of your data
privacy.exportDialogBody: To protect your data, enter your password again. Your copy will be ready within 7 days, and the download link works for 72 hours.
privacy.deleteBlockedTitle: Your account can't be deleted right now
privacy.deleteBlockedBody: You have an open request for help with our clinical team. We need your details to reach you; you can delete the account once the request is closed.
